reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown place Korah away from the swallowed tents, so that household belonged to Dathan and Abiram, leaving Korah's own sons alive.

sides.snippet: the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who appertained to Korah
sides.verseText: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who appertained to Korah, and all their goods.

sides.snippet: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn't die.
sides.verseText: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn't die.
